Q8165.reason: Caral’s complexity grew from organizing labor to dig and maintain irrigation canals that brought river water to fields in a dry valley; monuments were results of that organization.

Q8178.reason: When Han China and Rome collapsed, overland Silk Road trade became less safe and profitable, so merchants shifted toward Indian Ocean sea routes; salvation religions gained rather than lost appeal.

Q8118.reason: By mass the solar nebula was mostly hydrogen and helium, then hydrogen-compound ices, then rocks, then metals.
